# 4. Preliminary Analysis: Age Modeling

```{r}
#| label: prelim-models-calc
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Compare linear, quadratic, and natural cubic spline age terms
# to select the most appropriate functional form 

# --- Females ---
m_fem_lin <- brm(
  Survival ~ Age + (1 | Yr), 
  data = Data_female_scaled, 
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"), 
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 2000, iter = 6000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 1955807312
)

m_fem_quad <- brm(
  Survival ~ Age + I(Age^2) + (1 | Yr), 
  data = Data_female_scaled, 
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"), 
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 2000, iter = 6000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 1742327535
)

m_fem_spl <- brm(
  Survival ~ ns(Age, 3) + (1 | Yr), 
  data = Data_female_scaled, 
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"), 
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 2000, iter = 6000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 1088916962
)

# --- Males ---
m_mal_lin <- brm(
  Survival ~ Age + (1 | Yr), 
  data = Data_male_scaled, 
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"), 
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 2000, iter = 6000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 834896509
)

m_mal_quad <- brm(
  Survival ~ Age + I(Age^2) + (1 | Yr), 
  data = Data_male_scaled, 
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"), 
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 2000, iter = 6000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 551577029
)

m_mal_spl <- brm(
  Survival ~ ns(Age, 3) + (1 | Yr), 
  data = Data_male_scaled, 
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"), 
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 2000, iter = 6000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 1586254377
)
```

```{r}
#| label: prelim-results
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Compare out-of-sample predictive accuracy using LOO-CV
# --- Results: Females ---
m_fem_lin_loo  <- loo(m_fem_lin, cores = 4)
m_fem_quad_loo <- loo(m_fem_quad, cores = 4)
m_fem_spl_loo  <- loo(m_fem_spl, cores = 4)

loo_compare(m_fem_lin_loo, m_fem_quad_loo, m_fem_spl_loo)

# --- Results: Males ---
m_mal_lin_loo  <- loo(m_mal_lin)
m_mal_quad_loo <- loo(m_mal_quad)
m_mal_spl_loo  <- loo(m_mal_spl)

loo_compare(m_mal_lin_loo, m_mal_quad_loo, m_mal_spl_loo)
```
